a1_crop.coordinates: stored Cartesian x/y in mm; no rotation/wrap/replication
a1_crop.crop_algorithm: a1 native vertices only: theta=atan2(y,x); theta_mid=(min(theta)+max(theta))/2; theta interval midpoint +/-5 degrees intersect observed span; radial min/max; Cartesian bounding box of the 4 (r,theta) corner points, padded 0.5mm each direction. Never choose crop from errors.
a1_crop.quantity: stored norm and stored-vector error with same global fixed scales

polygons: Actual retained native triangles only; flat element color; no smoothing/interpolation/wrap/rotation/replication
unsupported: neutral gray unpainted background; do not draw stale a2 polygons
clipping: Panel count and area fractions over entire retained native support; crop changes viewport only
